jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
At Thales, we are looking for an experienced, innovative and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our team and help us manage our development environment and improve our software development process. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in developing, deploying, and maintaining cloud and hybrid applications.The successful candidate should be a highly organized, detail-oriented professional with a passion for problem solving and a commitment to technological innovation. We are looking for an individual with a strong technical background in DevOps methodologies, Azure Cloud, scripting, and a strong understanding of software development processes. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of success in the deployment and maintenance of cloud applications.We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and is able to effectively manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously. The successful candidate should possess excellent... verbal and written communication skills, as well as the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. The ideal candidate will also be highly motivated, eager to learn, and possess the ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and processes.The successful candidate must possess the following qualifications:• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in DevOps engineering or a related field• Expert knowledge of DevOps methodologies• Extensive experience in the deployment and maintenance of cloud applications• Proficiency in Azure Cloud, scripting and software development processes• Strong technical background in development, deployment, and maintenance of cloud and hybrid applications• Excellent verbal and written communication skills• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment• High level of motivation and eagerness to learn• Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and processesIf you think you have what it takes to join our team, we would love to hear from you!

Thales is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics

jobs_results.title: System Administrator / DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Incorporation in the API team belonging to the Platform department of our client.

This team develops and maintains API Gateways based on nginx and Kong, deploying on docker + Kubernetes in multi-cloud (private cloud + AWS) connecting multiple business and e-commerce applications to the world.

Your main job will be to support and evolve Elastic stack components (Elastic, Kibana, Logstash), continuous integration with Jenkins, Gitlab CI, infrastructure and architecture tasks helping an IT professional community of around 6,000 people worldwide.

The goal is stability, maximum automation and continuous improvement, as well as providing consulting to different teams. Strong self-management time management skills and ability to deal with uncertainty as well as variable workloads.

jobs_results.title: Backend & DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
This awesome gig is for someone who's ready to take on a dual role in backend development and DevOps. We're looking for a dynamic, versatile professional who's excited to tackle both.
Team Structure: You'll join our tight-knit team of 10 dedicated engineers, where you'll be collaborating with the squad to come up with innovative solutions for the energy industry.
• You'll develop, implement, and maintain scalable, high-performance backend systems using TypeScript and a microservices architecture.
• You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement new features and enhancements. Of course, you'll always be striving to improve code quality through writing unit tests, automation, and conducting code reviews.
• As our Backend & DevOps Engineer, you'll also implement and manage continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using GitOps principles and Kustomize. When infrastructure issues arise, you'll proactively monitor, diagnose, and troubleshoot them to... ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
• You'll work closely with the development team to optimize the deployment process and streamline development workflows using Kubernetes. We're always on the lookout for new technologies to improve efficiency and performance, so you'll also be researching and implementing these as needed.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• 3+ years of experience in backend development, preferably with TypeScript and microservicesStrong knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL
• Proficiency in containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes
• Experience with Kustomize, GitOps, and cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or AzureKnowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a collaborative team environment
• High English level (C1)
• Experience working with corporate clients
• Experience with self-hosted deployment of B2B software
• We offer a competitive salary and bonus structure. You'll enjoy an extremely steep learning curve in a fast-paced, high-tech B2B company with an international team that has a 'global citizen' mindset. We promote a culture of freedom and responsibility, where innovation is encouraged and nurtured.
Other benefits include:
• 23 official pay vacation days + bank holidays and days when the company does not operate
• Hybrid and flexible working environment
• Free coffee, tea, snacks, and fresh organic fruit
• Sports and wellness package, including monthly massages/ Ticket Restaurant
• Company-sponsored team fun events every quarter and other cool after-work activities

In FlexiDAO we embrace diversity by having and promoting an inclusive and diverse environment. Therefore, we are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, or gender identity or expression.

While we have listed certain requirements for this position, ​we encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if you don't meet every single requirement listed in the job description. If you're passionate about our mission and believe you have the skills and potential to contribute to our team, we want to hear from you.
• Phone/Google Meet interview with a Talent Recruiter
• Google Meet with our Backend team lead developer & CTO
• Google Meet for a technical Test

We don’t offer just a “job”. It’s about building cool stuff that matters, together with a great team.
If you see yourself working with us and can meet the key requirements, send your CV to join FlexiDAO to careers@flexidao.com

jobs_results.title: Product Owner - DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

The Workshop is a tech company that develops intuitive software for the online gaming industry. Our motto is to move “Fearlessly Forward” together. Cooperative innovation is at the center of everything we do – from our games, new products and technologies, to how we collaborate and share inspiration with one another.

Your mission

We are looking for a passionate Product Owner to join TWS’s DevOps department. Our mission is to create new and awesome tools that will empower our development teams to do things in a faster and safer way, whilst standardising processes to ensure all development teams are aligned with each other.

The DevOps department sets the strategy and direction for tools and standards that support our Software Development Lifecycle, including but not limited to: CI/CD, source code and binaries management, platform solutions (Kubernetes, Observability), database provisioning and infrastructure automation.

As a Product Owner in this space, you will ensure... our vision and roadmaps are in line with business’ objectives. You will work alongside other Product Owners, Engineering, Architecture and our clients. You will interact with people across our entire company. It is a great opportunity to help us further mature the overall DevOps ecosystem, and to deliver impactful and scalable initiatives across the company.

What you'll do
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Product Owner to help mature our delivery process. You will be part of a highly-skilled DevOps team who are usually involved in projects with the rest of verticals.
• Be on top of new product and technology trends to advance our capabilities, while balancing an excellent user experience
• Define and drive product vision, strategy and metrics, galvanizing teams to follow you
• Balance needs around usability, productivity, security and scale to create optimal experiences for TWS current and future clients
• Work with Engineering to ensure healthy delivery – including technical capabilities, happiness, resilience, and growth, as well as determining what we buy over what we build.
• Ensure the team is doing the right things. A healthy balance of innovation, support and maintenance is key for successful teams at TWS

What you'll bring
• You have a strong technical background and wide knowledge of the DevOps world.
• You are passionate about balancing delivery with exceptional user experience
• A customer-first mindset
• A high degree of proficiency in iterative development, understanding of Agile principles - Scaled Agile frameworks is a plus
• Hands-on experience managing all stages of the product life cycle
• Technical background with knowledge of software development and web technologies
• Excellent organizational skills
• Product Owner Qualifications
• A proactive self-starter attitude, with excellent project management skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire internal teams & stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment
• A high degree of organisation, individual initiative, and personal accountability
• An established background in launching software or services in partnership with engineering teams and high degree of proficiency in prototyping, iterative development, understanding of Agile principles

What's in it for you
• Inspiring and fulfilling work at an innovative and values-driven company creating cutting-edge tech
• Contemporary and accessible office environments with a range of workplace perks
• Six weeks’ paid leave for every four years of service
• Relocation package for you and your family including soft-landing package services to help you settle in (applicable in Spain, if you are moving from a different city/country to Malaga.)
• Being part of a team with a forward-looking, international mindset and agile working practices
• A friendly, inclusive and multicultural environment (we are made up of over 35 nationalities, speaking almost 30 languages)
• Wellbeing programmes, learning and personal growth opportunities
• A range of employee events throughout the year, including team building activities, Learning Labs, Hackathons and Designathons
• Opportunities to shape the tech community within and outside of the company, through mentoring and knowledge-sharing

Our values

We understand that great ideas come from great people, and great people thrive when they’re trusted to challenge, change, improve, and perfect our products and processes. Our forte lies in the diversity of our skills – and that comes from the diversity of our people.

The Workshop is committed to being a diverse and inclusive workplace, where we all learn together, trust each other, and value collaboration. We welcome candidates of all genders, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, nationality, belief (or lack thereof), and programming language preference. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer a friendly, supportive working environment for all. It’s a place where you can try new ideas, take risks, and enjoy the support to move Fearlessly Forward

jobs_results.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Company

HP is a Fortune 100 technology company with $58+ Billion in revenue, with over 50,000 employees operating in more than 170 countries around the world. We provide technology and services that help people and companies address their problems and challenges, and realize their possibilities, aspirations and dreams. We apply new thinking and ideas to create simpler, more valuable and trusted experiences with technology, continuously improving the way our customers live and work.

Position background

In the GTM analytics COE our mission is to deliver impact by building machine learning products to optimize pricing and marketing investments and provide guidance to our sales organization.

Within the Cloud Infrastructure team, we are ensuring that our Data Science teams have all the technology assets they need to build and deliver the AI/ML solutions they work on as well that our Big Data environment is secure and has an up time of 99.99999%. As a Cloud Engineer you will... contribute to the success of our team thru the development of new solutions, infrastructures, and maintenance of existing ones for which you will ensure their compliance with security policies.

We offer an international experience, collaborative culture, top rate experience in AI and ML and opportunity to create significant real-world impact.

What you will do
• Designs and establishes secure and performant data architectures.
• Deliver enhancements, updates and programming changes for portions and subsystems of infrastructure hosting data pipelines, repositories and models for structured/unstructured data.
• Analyzes design and determines coding, programming, and integration activities required based on general objectives and knowledge of overall architecture of product or solution.
• Write and executes complete testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portion of data system or component.
• Identify, debug and create solutions for issues with code and integration into data system architecture.
• Collaborates and communicates with project team regarding project progress and issue resolution.
• Represents the infrastructure team supporting the data engineering for all phases of larger and more-complex development projects.
• Provides guidance and mentoring to less experienced staff members.
• Investigate and suggest ways to improve and reduce operational costs.

What you will need:
• Bachelor’s in computer engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field
• 4+ years on a similar role.
• Ability to work under pressure as well as in autonomous mode.
• In-depth knowledge of provisioning and managing on-premises Windows physical and virtual infrastructure using Hyper-V.
• In-depth knowledge of provisioning and managing cloud services on Microsoft Azure.
• Review and Implement DevOps best practices, apply CI and CD principles (best practice) in supporting the build & release life cycle.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to represent complex algorithms in software.
• Strong understanding of database technologies and management systems, in particular Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL database services.
• Experience on database architecture testing methodology, including execution of test plans, debugging, and testing scripts and tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
• Experience designing data systems/solutions to manage complex data and ability to effectively communicate product architectures, design.
• Experience with container orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes.
• Strong experience in at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, C#, .NET Core and .Net framework.
• Experience with IaC frameworks such as Azure Resource Manager, Terraform, Microsoft PowerShell.

Nice to Have
• Experience on Linux Operating Systems.
• Experience on NoSQL databases.
• Experience working on distributed computing systems.
• Experience with different cloud providers systems such as AWS or GCP

Who We Are

At HP, we believe in the power of ideas. We use ideas to put technology to work for everyone. And we believe that ideas thrive best in a culture of teamwork. That is why everyone – at every level in every function, is encouraged to think big, have original ideas and express and share them. We trust anything can be achieved if you really believe in it, and we will invest in your ideas to change lives and the way people work. This vision is what sets us apart as a company. At HP, we work across borders and without limits. Global virtual teams share resources, pool their big ideas to solve our biggest business opportunities. Everyone is valued for the unique skills, experiences and perspective they bring. That’s how we work at HP. And this is how ideas and people grow

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Deliverect

As a rapidly scaling global SaaS unicorn, Deliverect stands at the forefront of revolutionising technological solutions for the dynamic hospitality and Q-commerce sectors. Our mission is clear: to empower ambitious individuals with the skills and knowledge to make a positive impact on business. Developing in their professional careers, all the while being a part of something larger than themselves.

Omnichannel Innovation

Our omnichannel solution serves as the driving force behind order management for fast-paced operations, providing seamless experiences for businesses and their customers. With real-time insights and analytics, our versatile and adaptable solution caters to businesses of all sizes in the hospitality and Q-commerce industry, spanning restaurants, delivery services, grocery stores, and more. With Deliverect, businesses don't just survive; they thrive in an ever-changing global landscape.

Unlocking Benefits

Our meticulously crafted solutions provide a... multitude of benefits:

Growing Sales: Acting as a catalyst, we propel businesses to expand their customer base, accelerating order processing and improving order delivery times.

Optimised Operations: As specialists in fine-tuning business operations, we elevate overall efficiency while concurrently reducing operational costs.

Elevated Customer Satisfaction: Deliverect supports businesses in offering customers faster delivery times and a seamless ordering experience, ensuring unparalleled customer satisfaction.

Dynamic Team and Values

Embarking on our global expansion journey across strategic hubs in Europe, North America, South America, Oceania, Asia, and the Middle East, Deliverect is fuelled by ambition and mutual respect. Our tight-knit team thrives on continuous enhancements and personal growth.

Guided by unwavering values of ownership, collaboration, and learning, we provide individuals with an environment to conquer challenges and build determination. Our culture is deeply rooted in our growth story, originating from our Belgian startup roots. From our humble beginnings, we defied all odds in unity, transforming into a global force in the tech industry. We leave a positive impact on our customers and the individuals we serve, creating a lasting legacy in our collective journey.

Department Focus

At the heart of Deliverect beats the powerhouse known as Cloud Platform. We don't just offer a platform; we provide a reliable, scalable, and secure engine propelling businesses towards delivering the ultimate customer experience. Picture us as a squad of highly skilled engineers and architects, fuelled by a passion for crafting innovative and customer-centric solutions. Our relentless pursuit involves constant refinement and the infusion of new features into our platform, all designed to propel our customers towards unparalleled success.

In today's fiercely competitive landscape, businesses must navigate a robust cloud software system. Enter our realm—we are the leaders on this mission. Our dedicated team is committed to aiding our loyal users in achieving their business goals and, in turn, providing their customers with a leading-edge ordering experience. We thrive in the realm where cutting-edge technology meets a commitment to excellence, ensuring that every interaction, every order, and every experience is nothing short of extraordinary

In this critical role, you will be helping Deliverect build, maintain, and scale infrastructure. We are looking for someone who can help us with our high-availability, deployment, and monitoring solutions.

A Typical Day:
• Improve the high availability of our Dockerised microservices
• Launch services in Kubernetes
• Deploy releases to production and staging environments
• Improve upon our CI/CD pipeline
• Build and maintain monitoring tools: logging, performance, uptime, and tracing
• Optimise DB performance
• Help with tooling and development
• Help with proposing and architecting new features

Your Expertise:
• Excellent Linux skills
• 2+ years experience with Docker
• Experience with Cloud environments (Google Cloud is a plus)
• Experience with databases (NoSQL experience is a big plus)
• Knowledge of Python development
• Experience with a variety of API standards (REST, JSON-RPC, SOAP/XML)
• Experience with Git and the CLI
• Experience with API clients like Postman or Insomnia
• Understanding of CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Travis, CircleCI
• Monitoring experience (we use Grafana but experience with alternatives is fine)
• Excellent written and oral communication skills

Join Deliverect: Where You Shape Tomorrow's Success

At Deliverect, we're not just seeking team members; we're on the lookout for dynamic individuals who thrive in a fast-paced SaaS environment. We are fueled by perceptive, ambitious, and determined professionals who embrace challenges and turn them into opportunities for innovation.

jobs_results.description:
Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey in Contextual Decision Intelligence?

If you're passionate about enabling individuals and organisations to make informed decisions most efficiently, we have an exceptional opportunity for you!

Our trailblazing client is spearheading a new era of meaningful data. Their breakthrough software connects internal and external data, revealing unseen relationships. This powers cutting-edge AI tackling critical challenges in risk, fraud, AML, and beyond.

Partnering with elite global banks, insurers, and tech giants, our client is revolutionising decision intelligence. Come shape the future at this fast-rising analytics disruptor. Step into the realm of data analysis redefined.

What You'll Dive Into:

In this role, you’ll enhance platform availability, resilience, usability and security, while reducing operational burden. Staying at the forefront of cloud tech, you’ll create new integrated offerings for customers to leverage.

Using leading... DevOps techniques, you’ll collaborate with top engineers to support software releases. This is a premier opportunity to showcase your skills on an industry-leading platform enabling groundbreaking AI. Immerse yourself in their acclaimed cloud landscape that’s redefining what’s possible with data and analytics.

Key Achievements:

Join a team of over 500 talented professionals. Become part of an organisation with a valuation exceeding $900 million. Proud recipient of the Google Cloud 2020 Industry Solutions Partner of the Year award.

Their Technology Stack:
• A strong focus on Docker/Kubernetes/Istio
• DevOps tooling/automation written with Bash/Python/Groovy/Jenkins/Golang
• Provisioning software/frameworks (Elasticsearch/Spark/Hadoop/PostgreSQL)
• Infrastructure Management - CasC, IasC (Ansible, Terraform, Packer)
• Log and metric aggregation with Fluentd, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager
• Public Cloud, primarily GCP, but also AWS and Azure

We seek developers and engineers who:
• Relish designing and delivering high-quality solutions to complex problems. You see the big picture.
• Have in-depth experience with cloud and DevOps tech like Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS.
• Know how to build robust and secure systems end-to-end.
• Have scripting/programming chops and a passion for automation.
• Love managing infrastructure and leveraging Linux.
• Take pride in your work and hold yourself to high standards.

Their acclaimed platform is waiting for your engineering skills to help enhance and scale its capabilities. Bring your expertise in cloud, DevOps and infrastructure to propel innovation in AI and data analytics. Help them redefine what’s possible

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (mid or senior role)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

We help the world see new possibilities and inspire change for better tomorrows. Our analytic solutions bridge content, data, and analytics to help business, people, and society become stronger, more resilient, and sustainable.

Job Description

DevOps is the practice of operations and development engineers participating together in the entire service lifecycle, from design through the development process to production support. DevOps is also characterized by operations staff making use many of the same techniques as developers for their systems work.

This role’s main purpose is to increase a product team’s ability to deliver applications and services at high velocity, via a combination of automation, tools, process changes, practices, etc.

Following the foundations of the DevOps I and II, the DevOps Engineer III is the main point of contact within a product team for all the DevOps activities. This role is a key part of the Software Development/Testing... Lifecycle, being an active part of technical reviews and maintaining the roadmap in that product team, being an example for another DevOps and contributing to extend the DevOps Culture at Sequel.

Main responsibilities:
• Leads strategic improvements within a Development Team autonomously.
• Design and implement of Build and Release improvements to the Development Team.
• Work closely with products and architecture team to design and support new architectures (containers, microservices, serverless).
• Design and implement new automation tools.
• Define and deliver DevOps strategic improvements.
• Assist with providing third-level support to business users.
• Work on new and existing applications along with enhancements to websites, web applications, and infrastructure.
• Write design technical documents.
• Participate actively on reviews and technical design meetings and provide valuable feedback.
• Mentor other DevOps Engineers (levels I, II).
• Run training sessions for Development Teams so the knowledge on the CI/CD tools and processes are understood.
• Suggests new tools and participates in the evaluation of those.
• Takes responsibility for the delivery of the changes coordinating people in the team.
• Responsible of the follow-up of the implementation of the strategic improvements and best practices in each DevOps team.
• Write design technical documents. Makes sure all the key processes are documented.
• Share information in DevOps forums.
• Completes all special projects and other duties as assigned.
• Any other duties commensurate to the grade of the role.

#LI-SD2 #LI-Hybrid

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree preferred in Computer Science or other relevant field and extensive related experience.
• Working knowledge of all phases of the software development life cycle.
• Good knowledge of object-oriented programming concepts, testing pyramid and design patterns.
• Good knowledge of functional programming concepts.
• Good knowledge of SQL Server administration.
• Good knowledge of infrastructure/application level monitoring services.
• Good knowledge of Container architectures, good practices and know-how, including container orchestrator services like Kubernetes and Swarm.
• Deep understanding of Version Control System (migrate between VCS, troubleshoot issues with VCS, analysing performance issues).
• Deep understanding of Build and Package process (understanding dependency issues, managing Framework updates, analysing performance issues, optimize packaging process).
• Deep understanding of Release process (zero-downtime deployments, after-release testing, analysing performance issues, application monitoring).
• Good understanding of infrastructure concepts (performance analysis, post-mortem analysis).
• Ability to do a risk analysis.
• Ability to provide estimates and provide cost-based design.
• Ability to review other team members work.
• Demonstrated ability to implement new automation tools.
• Demonstrated ability to improve CI/CD process.
• Demonstrated ability to write technical documents including database design, application design and ongoing documentation of changes and modifications.
• Demonstrated ability to spread knowledge across the team.
• Set measurable goals and meets them.
• Good communication skills. Ability to lead stand-ups, retrospective and technical review meetings.

Additional Information

For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster.

At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed.

For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and second consecutive year in Poland. We value learning, caring and results and make inclusivity and diversity a top priority. In addition to our Great Place to Work® Certification, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer and Best Employer for Women, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations.

Verisk Businesses

Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision

Claims Solutions — supports end-to-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences

Property Estimating Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day-to-day workflows the most efficient

Extreme Event Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to extreme events.

Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end-to-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance

Marketing Solutions — delivers data and insights to improve the reach, timing, relevance, and compliance of every consumer engagement

Life Insurance Solutions – offers end-to-end, data insight-driven core capabilities for carriers, distribution, and direct customers across the entire policy lifecycle of life and annuities for both individual and group.

Verisk Maplecroft — provides intelligence on sustainability, resilience, and ESG, helping people, business, and societies become stronger

Verisk Analytics is an equal opportunity employer.

All members of the Verisk Analytics family of companies are equal opportunity employers. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, veteran's status, age or disability.

http://www.verisk.com/careers.html

Unsolicited resumes sent to Verisk, including unsolicited resumes sent to a Verisk business mailing address, fax machine or email address, or directly to Verisk employees, will be considered Verisk property. Verisk will NOT pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer - Engineering Operations
jobs_results.description:
About Us

Chainlink Labs is the primary contributing developer of Chainlink, the decentralized computing platform powering the verifiable web. Chainlink is the industry-standard platform for providing access to real-world data, offchain computation, and secure cross-chain interoperability across any blockchain. Chainlink Labs helps power verifiable applications for banking, DeFi, global trade, and gaming by collaborating with some of the world’s largest financial institutions, notably Swift, DTCC, and ANZ. Chainlink Labs also works with top Web3 teams, including Aave, Compound, GMX, Maker, and Synthetix. Chainlink Labs was ranked in Newsweek’s 100 Most Loved Workplaces 2023 in both the United States and United Kingdom.

The Engineering Team

At Chainlink Labs, our engineering team pushes the scale and capabilities of decentralized applications across the industry. The Chainlink Network holds >70% market share in the oracle space, solving real-world problems by enabling smart contracts... to securely interact with off-chain data/computation.

We value talented and driven craftsmen who work collaboratively to tackle complex challenges, deliver product impact, and grow as builders. Join us and shape the future of blockchain technology and decentralized finance.

About the Role

The Engineering Operations team supports product teams by providing specialized expertise required to keep products in a safe and reliable functioning condition while maximizing delivery velocity. Engineering Operations functions as a security, release, and operational layer ensuring optimal balance between feature delivery velocity and product stability. We focus on minimizing operational risk, improving tempo, and automating manual processes that prevent software delivery from being repeatable and stable.

DevOps Engineer combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. Much of our software development focuses on building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. We are distributed across time zones and continents, and we embrace remote work.

In the EngOps team, we follow the infrastructure-as-code approach and practice GitOps. We all have different backgrounds and are determined to help you succeed no matter where you are or who you are. If you think you would do a great job at Chainlink, we are looking forward to speaking with you, even if you don't match 100% of the job requirements: those describe people we've usually had a great time working with, but they're not a tick-box exercise.

Your Impact
• Automate and reduce complexities around product operations
• Evangelize and enact best practices as experts
• Make tooling user-friendly and accessible to create self-sufficient operational experts across the company and our network of Node Operators
• Continue delivering operational tasks in agreed SLOs to expand scalability and reliability
• Deliver high product velocity while protecting reliability and operability
• Pair with engineers from across the company to help with troubleshooting, deploy new services, and figure out how to increase developer velocity and eliminate pain points
• Support production systems by being on-call
• Provide technical leadership for the local team and work closely with partner team technical leads

Requirements
• Excitement for blockchain, Web 3.0, and similar decentralized technologies
• Be willing to go on-call. Reliability is our most important feature, because on-call is an essential component of a reliable system we take it very seriously
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience
• At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in DevOps or SRE and Software engineering background. We’re big on building internal tools and automation, doing code reviews, etc.
• Experience designing and implementing automation tools in one or more programming languages
• Experience with CI/CD. You know how to deploy your services reliably and have used tools like GitHub Actions, CirceCI, TravisCI, or Jenkins to achieve that
• Experience with scripting and configuration management. You can write scripts to automate routine tasks and have familiarity with tools like Ansible, Puppet and Chef
• Experience with infrastructure provisioning tools helping to create and manage a collection of related resources like Terraform, CloudFormation (AWS), Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Google Cloud Deployment Manager, etc.
• Experience with distributed systems and container orchestration. You have maintained or even built Kubernetes clusters before and feel comfortable deploying complete new services on them or have familairy with Docker
• Experience with Git-based version control systems that keep track of changes to code, configuration and enable collaboration
• Strong communication skills. It’s a fully remote job that requires working with multiple stakeholders across all of Engineering. Great communication is as essential as the technical knowledge for this role

Desired Qualifications
• Experience working in fully remote teams across time zones. We are spread out across time zones and prefer asynchronous communication and documenting our work instead of calling meetings
• Experience working in scale-up companies of a similar size or early-stage startups
• Experience in blockchain or DeFi space
• Experience with monitoring and logging. You know how to export metrics to Prometheus, have built a Grafana dashboard or two, and have experience with a centralized logging solution like the Elastic Stack, Spunk or LogDNA
• Contributions to open-source projects or participation in tech communities. Being involved with the greater tech community, working with people outside of the company, mentoring other people, giving conference talks—in other words, the desire to share knowledge

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us via this form.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Information collected and processed as part of your Chainlink Labs Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required

In the EngOps team, we follow the infrastructure-as-code approach and practice GitOps. We all have different backgrounds and are determined to help you succeed no matter where you are or who you are. If you think you would do a great job at Chainlink, we are looking forward to speaking with you, even if you don't match 100% of the job requirements: those describe people we've usually had a great time working with, but they're not a tick-box exercise.

Your Impact
• Automate and reduce complexities around product operations
• Evangelize and enact best practices as experts
• Make tooling user-friendly and accessible to create self-sufficient operational experts across the company and our network of Node Operators
• Continue delivering operational tasks in agreed SLOs to expand scalability and reliability
• Deliver high product velocity while protecting reliability and operability
• Pair with engineers from across the company to help with troubleshooting, deploy new services, and figure out how to increase developer velocity and eliminate pain points
• Support production systems by being on-call
• Provide technical leadership for the local team and work closely with partner team technical leads

Requirements
• Excitement for blockchain, Web 3.0, and similar decentralized technologies
• Be willing to go on-call. Reliability is our most important feature, because on-call is an essential component of a reliable system we take it very seriously
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience
• At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in DevOps or SRE and Software engineering background. We’re big on building internal tools and automation, doing code reviews, etc.
• Experience designing and implementing automation tools in one or more programming languages
• Experience with CI/CD. You know how to deploy your services reliably and have used tools like GitHub Actions, CirceCI, TravisCI, or Jenkins to achieve that
• Experience with scripting and configuration management. You can write scripts to automate routine tasks and have familiarity with tools like Ansible, Puppet and Chef
• Experience with infrastructure provisioning tools helping to create and manage a collection of related resources like Terraform, CloudFormation (AWS), Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Google Cloud Deployment Manager, etc.
• Experience with distributed systems and container orchestration. You have maintained or even built Kubernetes clusters before and feel comfortable deploying complete new services on them or have familairy with Docker
• Experience with Git-based version control systems that keep track of changes to code, configuration and enable collaboration
• Strong communication skills. It’s a fully remote job that requires working with multiple stakeholders across all of Engineering. Great communication is as essential as the technical knowledge for this role

Desired Qualifications
• Experience working in fully remote teams across time zones. We are spread out across time zones and prefer asynchronous communication and documenting our work instead of calling meetings
• Experience working in scale-up companies of a similar size or early-stage startups
• Experience in blockchain or DeFi space
• Experience with monitoring and logging. You know how to export metrics to Prometheus, have built a Grafana dashboard or two, and have experience with a centralized logging solution like the Elastic Stack, Spunk or LogDNA
• Contributions to open-source projects or participation in tech communities. Being involved with the greater tech community, working with people outside of the company, mentoring other people, giving conference talks—in other words, the desire to share knowledge

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us via this form.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Information collected and processed as part of your Chainlink Labs Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required

DevOps Lead Engineer

BARCELONA, SPAIN

KYIV, UKRAINE

SOFTWARE ENGINEERING & RESEARCH

HYBRID

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced DevOps Lead Engineer to lead our DevOps team and drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of our DevOps practices. As a key member of our technology leadership team, the DevOps Lead Engineer will play a crucial role in enhancing our software development lifecycle, ensuring seamless collaboration between development and operations teams, and optimizing our infrastructure for efficiency and scalability.
• Provide strategic leadership in the design and implementation of DevOps processes and practices
• Collaborate with executive leadership to align DevOps initiatives with overall business objectives
• Develop and communicate a clear vision for the DevOps team and its contributions to the organization
• Lead and... mentor a team of DevOps engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
• Set performance expectations, conduct regular performance reviews, and support professional development
• Design and implement robust, scalable, and secure DevOps solutions that meet current and future organizational needs
• Oversee the integration of automation tools and technologies to streamline development and deployment processes
• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines to facilitate rapid and reliable delivery of software
• Ensure the automation of testing, deployment, and monitoring processes to minimize manual intervention
• Optimize cloud and on-premises infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness
• Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) practices to enable consistent and repeatable infrastructure deployments
• Establish and maintain monitoring and alerting systems to ensure the health and performance of applications and infrastructure
• Develop incident response plans and lead the response to critical incidents, minimizing downtime and impact on users
Your profile
• Bachelor's or an advanced degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field
• Proven experience (5 years) in a DevOps leadership role with a track record of successful implementation of DevOps practices
• Expertise in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
• Strong background in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, Shell, Ansible)
• In-depth knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
• Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) and configuration management tools
• Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving innovation through DevOps practices, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of our organization. Join us in shaping the future of our technology landscape!
Location and type of contract
• Full-time
• Hybrid
• Mid-senior level
